input.description: Check email in mapper and DTO

content.text: The check belongs in `addOwner` (V1 handles `POST /api/owners`). Per the cost model, a single inline branch in one file is cheaper than adding a new helper file (which would double the whole cost via the file multiplier). Emails are already stored lower-cased via `Owner.setEmail`, so an `equals` comparison is effectively a lower-cased match.
